nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what happened to the source blue mug that was left of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Complete only if the same source blue mug is identifiable in the edited image to the right of the headphones, with no evidence it remains at its original left position. Partial if that same mug is identifiable and has moved toward the right but is not yet to the right of the headphones. Absent if the source mug remains in its original position with no movement toward the right. If identity, movement, or persistence cannot be established, return unknown. A separate mug appearing to the right does not establish movement of the source mug; do not infer progress from low confidence alone.
nodes.binding: Source image: the blue mug left of the black headphones. Reference: the same black headphones in both images.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
